claim: Payload referencing in multi-agent collaboration improves goal success rate and reduces communication overhead, but increases user-perceived turn latency.
falsifier: Implement payload referencing in a similar multi-agent system and measure goal success rate, communication tokens, and latency with and without it.

conditions: evaluated on travel, mortgage, and software domains
particularly beneficial in code-heavy software domain
using Claude 3.5 Sonnet (20240620) as supervisor and Claude 3.0 as specialists
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, tasks, model configurations, and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Enabling payload referencing–goal success rate, communication boundary
